hero-desc:
Ukrainian design soul meets German perfection:
We create spaces with a vibrant aesthetic and thoughtful functionality—for a home filled with life, harmony, and inspiration.
about_subtext: A combination of creativity and technical expertise.
about_lead: A home always tells its own story. I am Olena Suvorova, founder of Libri Interiors. My passion for interior design has been with me for many years — from my creative beginnings in Ukraine all the way to Germany.
about_p2: In our view, good design emerges when aesthetics, functionality, and individuality are in harmony. Every home is as unique as the people who live in it. That’s why we think in terms of solutions, not standards.
about_goal: Our goal is to bring your vision to life. After all, for us, good design begins where beauty and practicality go hand in hand.
role_alex: The technical genius behind these ideas.
quotes.hero_quote: Where others see limitations, we see opportunities. Together, we turn ideas into places where it’s a pleasure to live.

services_description_1: Unlimited inspiration. Digital consultations on flexible interior design concepts. You’ll receive a carefully curated mood board, color schemes, and a ready-to-go shopping list—simple, convenient, and online.
services_description_2: Get a feel for your new home even before it’s built. Photorealistic 3D renderings will give you complete confidence in the colors, lighting, and materials. No surprises—just joyful anticipation.
services_description_3: Custom-designed architecture for comfort. From the perfect floor plan to the lighting concept—we design spaces that perfectly match your lifestyle and aesthetic preferences.
process_step1_desc: We listen carefully to you. We understand your lifestyle, your needs, and your budget.
process_step2_desc: Your idea is coming to life. We develop floor plans, color schemes, and photorealistic 3D renderings.
process_step3_desc: Perfection down to the smallest detail. Creation of all technical drawings and selection of appropriate materials and furniture.
process_step4_desc: From idea to reality. Professional guidance to help you achieve a result that fully matches your dreams.
cta_story_description:
Perhaps you're already dreaming about your future home.
Tell us about it.
Together, we'll turn it into a place you'll look forward to coming home to every day.
faq_title: The questions you ask yourself—the answers that inspire you
answer1: Don't worry, we'll guide you through the entire process. It all starts with a cup of coffee (or a video call), during which we’ll learn about your dreams and habits. Then we’ll turn your wishes into a well-thought-out 3D design—down to the smallest details and perfect execution.
question2: Do you also offer consultations for individual rooms?
answer2: Of course. Big changes often start with small details. Whether it's redesigning your living room, creating an inspiring home office, or completely decorating a villa—we pay the same attention to detail to every square meter.
answer3: Good design knows no boundaries. Thanks to our well-thought-out e-design concept, we’ll support your project no matter where you’re located. You’ll receive photorealistic 3D renderings, floor plans, and a ready-to-use shopping list—no matter where you are.
question4: What happens if I don't like the first sketch?
answer4: Design is a dialogue, not a monologue. We’ll listen carefully to you before we draw the first line. If something isn’t quite 100% what you had in mind, we’ll work together to refine the concept until you say, “Yes, that’s exactly what I need!”
question5: Are you willing to work within our budget?
answer5: Transparency is our priority. Aesthetics isn’t a matter of an unlimited budget, but of thoughtful design. From the very beginning, we plan everything realistically so that your dream can come true without any financial surprises.
question6: Why should you choose to work with Libri Interiors?
answer6: Because you get two perspectives on your project. We combine creative ideas with technical precision. You won’t have to choose between beauty and functionality—with us, you’ll get both from a single source.
contact_tag: We're always ready to help you
contact_desc: Do you have questions about our services, want to start a new project, or simply share your initial ideas? We look forward to hearing from you and will get back to you within 24 hours.
